title: Cottage Cheese Oat Pancakes
summary: Fluffy cottage cheese oat pancakes packed with protein and fiber. Naturally sweetened with banana, freezer-friendly, and ready in minutes.
steps: Add all ingredients to a blender. Blend until smooth and creamy, scraping down the sides as needed. Stir really well and let it sit for 5 minutes or so. This helps the oats absorb some liquid and makes the pancakes fluffier.

Heat a nonstick skillet or griddle over medium heat and lightly grease with oil or butter. Pour the batter onto the skillet (about 2–3 tablespoons per pancake). Cook for 2–3 minutes, until bubbles form on the surface and the edges look set. Flip and cook another 1–2 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Serve and enjoy!Delicious with fresh fruit, a dollop of yogurt, or a drizzle of maple syrup.
